## **Why Use a Website Ranking Checker?**

Checking your website ranking from your own browser does not show your real position. Results are personalized based on your location, browsing history, account, and device. The ranking you see for your site is not the ranking your customers see. This gap is bigger than most people realize, your personalized results can be 5 to 15 positions higher than your actual rank.

A website ranking checker fixes this discrepancy by running an unbiased query from a clean server, with no personalization, from the country and device you specify. It also pulls the full top 100 results, not just page 1, so you can see exactly how far from page 1 you are and which competitors are sitting between you and the top position.

Without accurate rank data, every decision you make about your website content and structure is based on guesswork. You may be investing time and effort into pages that already rank well, while pages that need the most attention remain ignored. A website rank finder gives you the full picture so you can prioritize correctly.

FreeSERP runs your check from a clean, location-specific IP address in the country you choose. No login history. No browser cache. No personalization. Just the real, unfiltered position your page holds for that keyword in that market, the same result your potential customers would see when they search.

**Run a check above to see your actual website ranking—not the one your browser shows when you are logged in.**

**Global Website Ranking Checker**

Your website does not rank the same way in every country. A keyword you hold position 3 for in the United States may sit at position 22 in the United Kingdom, position 7 in Canada, or position 1 in Australia. If you are making decisions based on rankings from a single location, you are missing most of the information.

FreeSERP is a global website ranking checker that supports 190+ countries and major cities. You choose the country and device type before every check, and the tool returns the live ranking for that exact market. This matters especially for businesses serving multiple regions, because a ranking strategy that works in one country may be completely wrong for another.

Local ranking differences are driven by several factors — competition levels vary by market, content relevance is judged differently by location, and the pages that rank on page 1 in one country are often entirely different from those ranking in another. A global website ranking checker lets you audit each market independently rather than averaging results that hide critical gaps.

Use FreeSERP to check your website ranking across your key markets in a single session. Compare positions country by country, identify where you are strong and where you are losing ground, and build a targeted plan for each region. No paid subscription required — the global ranking check is fully free.

**Common Questions**

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

*Common questions about website ranking checker accuracy and tracking. Still stuck? Email support@freeserp.com.*

**Is the website ranking checker really free?**

Yes—website rank free, with unlimited checks, no credit card, no trial, and no rate limit on manual checks. You can check any domain, any keyword, and any country as many times as you need without ever entering a payment method.

Saved tracking projects are limited to 10 keywords per project on the free plan, with 30 days of rank history included. Paid plans unlock unlimited keywords per project and extended history for teams that need more depth.

**How accurate is the website ranking data?**

We pull live, depersonalized results from a clean IP in the country you select. We do not estimate or extrapolate—every position is a real query we ran the moment you clicked the button. The accuracy matches paid tools for the top 100 positions.

Personalized results from your browser can show your pages 5 to 15 positions higher than their actual rank. Our website ranking checker eliminates that bias completely by querying from a neutral server with no login history, no cache, and no location tied to your account.

**Can I check my website ranking for any country?**

Yes. Pick from 190+ supported countries in the location dropdown. Our global website ranking checker pulls results at the country level, so every check returns the live ranking for the exact market you select — not an averaged or estimated position.

Rankings differ significantly between countries. Always check each target market separately to get an accurate picture of where you stand in each region.

**Does the website rank tracker check mobile and desktop separately?**

Yes. Toggle the Device button before running the check to switch between mobile and desktop. Mobile and desktop rankings often differ by 2 to 5 positions, and for keywords with high mobile search volume those differences can be even larger.

If you are optimizing for mobile users—which matters for most local and service-based businesses— always run both checks and compare. A page that ranks well on desktop may be significantly lower on mobile due to page speed or mobile usability issues.

**How often should I check my website ranking?**

For active optimization work, check daily for your 5 to 10 highest-priority keywords and weekly for the rest. Rankings shift regularly because of algorithm updates, competitor activity, and content changes across the web. Checking once a month gives you too little data to understand what is actually happening.

Set up a saved tracking project for your most important keywords and review the 30-day history chart weekly. This gives you a trend line that shows whether your rankings are stable, improving, or declining—and flags problems early before they affect your traffic.

**Can I use this tool as a website rank finder for competitor domains?**

Yes. Enter any domain — yours or a competitor's — and check their ranking for any keyword in any country. The website rank finder works identically for any URL, so you can audit competitor positions the same way you check your own.

Use competitor rank checks before client pitches to show prospects exactly where they stand versus the competition. You can also use the Competitor Analysis feature to compare a competitor's full ranking profile against your pages and identify the gaps you need to close.

**Why is my website ranking lower than I expected?**

The most common reasons are weak internal linking to the page, thin content compared to the top-ranking pages for that keyword, slow page speed, or a mismatch between your page content and what people are actually looking for when they search that keyword.

Run the recommendation plan after a check—it analyzes the pages ranking above you and identifies which of these factors is hurting your position most. This gives you a prioritized action list rather than a general checklist of things to improve.

**Do you store my data?**

We store the keywords and domains you save to tracked projects. We do not sell your data, run ads against your usage, or share information with third parties under any circumstances.

Anonymous one-off checks—where you run a check without saving it to a project— are not logged to your account. If you want your data removed, you can delete your project at any time, and it will be cleared from our system.
